user.title: MAVIS Aviation Charts
user.description: Log in to mavis.metoffice.gov.uk in your browser, then open DevTools → Application → Cookies → https://mavis.metoffice.gov.uk and copy the value of the 'auth_token' cookie.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid or expired auth token. Check the token value and try again.

abort.already_configured: MAVIS Aviation Charts is already configured.

init.title: MAVIS Options
init.description: To renew an expired token: log in to mavis.metoffice.gov.uk, then open DevTools → Application → Cookies and copy the 'auth_token' value.

auth_token_expired.title: MAVIS auth token has expired
auth_token_expired.description: The MAVIS Aviation Charts integration can no longer access MAVIS. Log in to mavis.metoffice.gov.uk in your browser, copy the 'auth_token' cookie value, then go to Settings → Integrations → MAVIS Aviation Charts → Configure and paste it in.
